c02.method: Minimum actual executed-step started_at through maximum executed-step completed_at; job.started_at is not an execution boundary.

interpretation_limits: Both repeats have the fixed baseline-to-zg profile order; no counterbalancing or randomized profile order. This is a design limitation, not a post hoc failure rule.

Job-level started_at is retained as reported and may be a queued placeholder. Serial execution requires actual completed-step intervals and native/outer-slot intervals; missing step timestamps leave it unconfirmed.
Separate GitHub-hosted jobs and per-profile absent-before-prepare installation volumes establish the configured fresh-runner boundary. This audit cannot inspect a terminated remote runner.
Within each pair Docker image/layer cache may be shared. Raw outer/trial times are descriptive, not comparisons with independently cleared image caches.
Only raw, measured usage-capture, evidence-audit and export durations are reported here. No historical metric is pooled, and no token/accounting or QA conclusion is made.
An execution pass does not establish that either repeat meets the frozen scoped-input, quality and relevant-MCP conditions; those require the separate evidence and blinded-grade audits.

detail.method: Minimum actual executed-step started_at through maximum executed-step completed_at; job.started_at is not an execution boundary.

limitations: Both repeats use the prospectively fixed baseline then zg order. Profiles were not counterbalanced or randomized; order effects cannot be separated from treatment effects by this design. This is an interpretation limit, not an added protocol gate.

Cleanup proof is the saved controller check that each private process group and the recorded trial containers stopped. This audit does not inspect the now-finished remote runner or claim global process absence.
The native CLI/config, pinned adapter/source, and recorded executable identities verify requested settings. Live HTTP request bodies and provider weight/version attestation were not retained.
The source image uses ubuntu:24.04 and normal dependency installation; the observed image ID is not an immutable upstream OS/dependency lock.
Controller-test ResourceWarnings, if present, are retained and flagged separately. Actual slot process/container cleanup is checked from each execution record.
No QA benefit, pass/fail grade, candidate verdict, total-provider cost, or token-use conclusion is made in this execution-only report.
Replay additionally requires the local execution Git commit, pinned upstream export, accepted proof archive, and frozen q001 source export; CLI paths are configurable.

native_task_identity.correction_history: The prior development execution audit initially equated these distinct hashes; its diagnostic and correction records remain in the immutable development archive. This confirmation audit independently recomputes both correctly from its first version.
native_task_identity.legacy_algorithm: Harbor Task.checksum delegates to dirhash 0.5.0 defaults: recursively hash sorted name/data (or name/dirhash) descriptors; NUL between sorted properties, double NUL between sorted entries; ignore empty directories.
native_task_identity.packager_algorithm: Harbor 0.18.0 publisher/packager.py: SHA256 of POSIX-relative file paths sorted lexically, each followed by NUL, file SHA256 hex and LF. All 1236 files survive the default ignores.
native_task_identity.path_semantics: Both hash file contents and relative names. Neither hashes the absolute task directory, root name, modes, owners or timestamps. The two algorithms intentionally produce different digests for identical task bytes.

c01.scope: saved execution and provenance only; root/child tool audit, usage arithmetic, and blind quality grading are separate

fresh: zg index built with remote embeddings (no seed/cache hit)
timing_boundary.interpretation: Report actual image IDs and environment setup times. A same-image pair can reuse Docker layers; image-ID equality alone does not identify which build steps hit cache.
timing_boundary.not_isolated: Docker image/layer cache within each job; no independent image-cache clearing is configured.
timing_boundary.prohibited_claim: Outer-slot/native-trial wall is not a comparison with Docker image/build caches independently cleared before both arms.
